snippet.title: Boston's Deadly Molasses Flood #History #Shorts
snippet.description:
In 1919, a tank of molasses burst in Boston, sending a deadly wave through the streets. It had been leaking for years — and the warning signs had gone unaddressed.

Music: ‘Night Vigil’ by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Trimmed and mixed with narration.
